interpretation: Andean traditional systems include altitude-adapted tubers and grains beyond a single generic crop suitability surface. A zero conditional crop yield on independently reconstructed current fields is an explicit evidence gap. Test transfer from the entire positive-density envelope of same-province, same-native-climate donors; do not choose donors or bounds using population.
donor_rule: province acamama_province, climate arctic, positive source crop density; all matching donors retained
reference_calendar: Inherited calendar multiplier removed. The canonical model removes reference development effectiveness before applying recipient management.
units: people per cultivated km2 at reference development; inferred whole cropping-system support, not a quoted measured 1337 yield
recipient_rule: Assigned historical system, positive current dry fields and zero original conditional rainfed support only
coverage: This is an inferred diagnostic, not independent measured Pisaq yield. No valid positive yield is replaced. Source crop-history and fallow assumptions remain uncertain.
exclusions: No population or density target used in donor selection or range calculation.
No additional hectares, harvest, irrigation, pasture or food building.
Do not treat a filled source gap as independently validated evidence.
